message.content: The footer displays a dark background with four columns: Brand (with "متاح الآن" chip and live clock), Quick Links, Services, and Connect. Small blue accent ticks precede each column heading. A row of social icons with distinct circular styling sits below the first column. The bottom row contains copyright text and a "made-with" note, separated by a subtle gradient hairline. The layout follows professional RTL alignment. No visual issues are apparent; the design is clean and well-structured.
